symmetric.description: Rayleigh + symmetric Mie: alpha_sym = P4/lambda^4 * (1 + P5/lambda^2)

asymmetric.description: Forward Mie: alpha_asym = P6 * (1 + P7/lambda^4 * (lambda - P8)^2)

absorption.source: SK calibration paper (arXiv:1307.0162), Eqs. 14-15, Table 3 + Pope & Fry (1997)
absorption.description: alpha_abs = P0*P1/lambda^4 + C(lambda); C = power law (<464nm) or Pope&Fry (>=464nm). Pope&Fry knots corrected 2026-07 to the authoritative omlc.org/spectra/water/data/pope97.txt values (converted 1/cm -> 1/m); the previous table was mistranscribed (blue values ~2x too low, causing a discontinuity at 464nm and non-smooth bumps).
